page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.3xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 12 dedicated physical cores and 12 vCPUs, operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. The processing power is delivered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor, allocating exactly one thread per physical core to ensure dedicated compute resources without hyperthreading.

This instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a high memory density provides a stable resource profile for memory-bound workloads. This configuration is suitable for hosting relational databases, in-memory caches, enterprise applications, and data processing tasks that require consistent CPU execution and a large memory footprint without the overhead of shared-core resource contention.
